fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private divided entrance road off S Fulton Pkwy (STOP sign + striped median in 2023-01 Street View pano sqDchmDuUdwg5rhCsh3UTA). The outer road entrance is open/uncontrolled, but driver reviews confirm a staffed check-in inside the yard where an attendant issues a pager and assigns a dock door, so the controlled truck gate is set back inside the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not directly resolvable in satellite at this resolution and screened by trees in Street View, but corroborated by multiple driver reviews describing an attendant check-in / pager system. Medium-confidence inference; flagged.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed check-in (attendant + pager) is reported, so the gate is manned rather than kiosk/app-only.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved aprons inside the entrance hold queued trucks before dock assignment (pager-call workflow implies an internal waiting area).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long divided entrance road plus deep internal yard aprons easily hold 3+ trucks between road and docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Main building has continuous dock banks on its NE/N, SW, and S faces with trailers backed in along most; overhead count well above 100 doors across the complex.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Multiple dedicated trailer-storage lots (N, NW, and central) full of trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on opposite building faces (NE/N inbound apron vs SW/S apron) suggest separated ship/receive; medium confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct large buildings on the Costco property: the primary solar-roof cross-dock plus a secondary building on the SW side, both dock-served.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entrance with striped median and ample paved apron width inside the gate leaves room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; no track visible.
